t: The LAP Telloy round 3-light bathroom ceiling spotlight in brushed steel provides adjustable directional lighting for modern interiors. This mains-powered ceiling light fixture is ideal for domestic bathrooms, en suites and utility rooms where targeted illumination is required. Featuring a durable metal body, a plastic diffuser and 3 adjustable spotlight heads, this IP44 rated fitting is suitable for bathroom zone 2 installations. Trade professionals and DIYers can easily install this stylish unit to upgrade existing lighting, requiring 3 x GU10 light bulbs up to a maximum wattage of 5W to deliver reliable, bright illumination.
b: Adjustable Spotlight Heads for Targeted Directional Lighting
Ideal for Bathrooms, En Suites & Utility Spaces
Easy Installation for Quick Bathroom Lighting Upgrades
